title: Security Act provides an earlier model
detail: The Special Powers Act later followed the Security Act of 1952 as part of the legal background to preventive state powers.

title: Public Safety Ordinance enacted
detail: The Public Safety Ordinance of 1958 was among the earlier legal instruments that the 1974 Act followed and replaced.

title: Scheduled Offences Order
detail: The Bangladesh Scheduled Offences (Special Tribunal) Order, 1972 formed another part of the legal background identified by Banglapedia.

title: Special Powers Act promulgated
detail: Bangladesh promulgated Act XIV of 1974. Its text states its purpose as preventing specified prejudicial activities and enabling speedy trial and effective punishment for certain grave offences.

title: Amendments omit provisions
detail: The consolidated statute records that the Special Powers (Amendment) Act, 1991 omitted provisions including section 16; Banglapedia describes the Act as having undergone amendments and deletions.
